description: A Drupal module class defining a views field plugin for linking to files, including configuration and rendering logic.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A Drupal views field plugin class for rendering links to files, with configurable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the file URL generator dependency.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, adding 'uri' to additional fields if linking to file is enabled.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the field value, applying link rendering if configured.
